name: Each implemented Deals lifecycle tab selects its matching workspace
description:
1. Sign in and open Deals.
2. Select the requested lifecycle tab and wait for loading to finish.
3. Verify the selected tab and Deals grid.
4. Return to All Deals and verify the default workspace is restored.
